response.sql: WITH patient_level AS (SELECT l.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.ALB) as patient_avg_alb, AVG(CASE WHEN l.`T-BIL` IS NOT NULL AND l.`T-BIL` != 0 AND l.UN IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(l.UN AS REAL) / l.`T-BIL` ELSE NULL END) as patient_avg_ratio FROM Laboratory l INNER JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID WHERE p.SEX IS NOT NULL AND p.SEX != '' GROUP BY l.ID, p.SEX), sex_level AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(patient_avg_alb) as sex_avg_alb, AVG(patient_avg_ratio) as sex_avg_ratio FROM patient_level GROUP BY SEX), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(sex_avg_alb) as overall_alb_mean FROM sex_level) SELECT s.SEX, s.sex_avg_alb, s.sex_avg_ratio, s.sex_avg_alb - o.overall_alb_mean as alb_above_mean FROM sex_level s CROSS JOIN overall_mean o WHERE s.sex_avg_alb > o.overall_alb_mean ORDER BY s.SEX

assumptions.assumption: T-BIL = 0 is excluded from UN/T-BIL ratio calculations, treating it as invalid data since division by zero yields an uncomputable ratio
